stars.description: Half stars: 1 = half a star, 10 = five stars.

subject.description: The com.professorbutts.sports.game or leaderboard record. A uri, not a strongRef, because game records are rewritten in place.

spoilers.description: True if the review gives away the result; viewers hide it until opened.

rootingFor.description: Team or person record the fan was pulling for, if any.

subjectCid.description: Optional: the version the fan saw, for display/audit only.

description: A fan's rating of a finished game or event, kept in the fan's own repo. One per fan per event: the record key is the subject's record key, so rating again replaces it. Older records may use a TID key. Together they make a Letterboxd-style game log.
